name: Beeking Search
author: Bartlomiej Mont

sections.description:
Tired of clunky search? Beeking Search supercharges your WooCommerce store!

  • Lightning-Fast & Smart: Delight customers with instant, relevant product suggestions as they type.
  • AI-Powered Understanding: Our AI knows what they’re looking for, leading to happier shoppers and more sales.
  • Always Accessible: A sleek floating search bar is available on every page.
  • Simple & Powerful: Easy setup, powerful results.

Stop losing sales to poor search. Experience the power of AI – try Beeking Search and unlock your store’s full potential!

External services

This plugin connects to the Beeking API (https://beeking.io/api) to:
– Verify license keys
– Add products
– Search products

Data sent: product data and user location.
Terms of use: https://beeking.io/terms-of-use
Privacy policy: https://beeking.io/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the beeking-search folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘Beeking Search’ menu in your WordPress admin panel to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
Can I test the AI features before committing?

Absolutely! We believe in letting you experience the power of Beeking AI firsthand.

  • Free Account on beeking.io: You can create a free account directly on our website, https://beeking.io.
  • Explore AI Capabilities: This allows you to test and see our advanced AI search features in action.
  • Experience the Difference: Discover how our semantic and prefix search can revolutionize your store’s product discovery before you decide to integrate it fully.

Does this plugin work with my theme?

Beeking Search is built to seamlessly integrate with the vast majority of WordPress and WooCommerce themes.

  • Broad Compatibility: We’ve designed it to be as universal as possible, especially with themes following WordPress and WooCommerce best practices.
  • Potential Conflicts: Issues are rare but can occasionally occur with themes that extensively alter standard WooCommerce functionalities or have heavily customized JavaScript.
  • Support & Testing: If you encounter any display issues, our support is here to help. We also recommend testing on a staging site if you have a highly customized theme.

How do I customize the appearance?

Tailoring the look of Beeking Search to match your brand is straightforward and requires no coding!

  • Intuitive Admin Panel: All customization options, such as colors (text, background, borders), search bar position, and placeholder text, are conveniently located in the Beeking Search settings page within your WordPress admin area.
  • Live Preview: Many settings offer a live preview so you can see changes instantly before saving.

upgrade_notice.1.1.2: API key validation logic was externally reviewed and confirmed. This entry is for version tracking.
upgrade_notice.1.1.1: This version introduces a crucial feature for data consistency: synchronization of product deletions. After all products are sent to the Beeking AI engine, the plugin will now send a list of current product IDs to remove any old or deleted products from the Beeking index. Additionally, this version includes fixes and enhancements for API key validation and internal code improvements.
upgrade_notice.1.1.0: This version introduces a new setting in the admin panel to control the live search debounce time. You can now fine-tune how quickly the search results appear after a user stops typing. Find this new option under Beeking Search -> Settings -> Search Bar Settings.
